steps.name: check-deps
steps.description: Verify t0106_long_pdnd_nsga2_300gen is completed (the substrate this task forks from).

steps.name: init-folders
steps.description: Create the mandatory task folder structure.

steps.name: research-papers
steps.description: Skipped: minimum-change replicate of t0106; no new literature evidence is required.

steps.name: research-internet
steps.description: Skipped: no new external information needed for a minimum-change replicate.

steps.name: research-code
steps.description: Review t0106 code (constants.py, nsga2_driver.py, random_init.py) and prior NSGA-II tasks to identify exactly what must be forked vs imported.

steps.name: planning
steps.description: Write plan.md covering fork strategy, the two minimal constant changes, smoke-gate checks, Vast.ai provisioning, cost cap, and HV-plateau stop criterion.

steps.name: setup-machines
steps.description: Provision a single Vast.ai CPU instance matching t0106's provisioning class.

steps.name: implementation
steps.description: Fork t0106 code, apply the two constant changes (seed 44 -> 77, pool restart 25 -> 10), local smoke gate, remote NSGA-II run with HV-plateau stop, collect per-cell predictions asset.

steps.name: teardown
steps.description: Destroy the Vast.ai instance and finalise cost tracking.

steps.name: creative-thinking
steps.description: Skipped: minimum-change replicate of t0106; alternative approaches would defeat the purpose of the like-for-like comparison.

steps.name: results
steps.description: Write results_summary.md, results_detailed.md, metrics.json, costs.json, charts.

steps.name: compare-literature
steps.description: Compare seed-77 DSI / PD frontier and joint-pass yield against t0106 (seed 44) and against published DSGC ratio DSI / PD references.

steps.name: suggestions
steps.description: Write suggestions.json based on the replicate outcome (multi-seed vs alternative-optimiser vs polar re-eval follow-ups).

steps.name: reporting
steps.description: Run all verificators, capture sessions, update task.json status, push PR, pre-merge check, merge.
